hero.title: Coffi
hero.subtitle: Be where you thrive
hero.description: The platform that is building Coworking 2.0 → a decentralized, intelligent and human network that connects remote workers and digital nomads with ideal spaces to thrive, anywhere in the world.

valueProposition.title: Value Proposition
valueProposition.content:
Coffi helps remote workers and digital nomads find the perfect space for their daily purpose (work, study, connect or have fun), integrating contextual data in real time (environment, noise, connection, community, etc.) to offer more productive, human and connected work experiences.

At the same time, it allows cafes, coworkings and work-friendly places (the spaces) to stand out and build loyalty among similar communities through information, metrics and rewards in the Coffi network.
valueProposition.quote: Coffi turns every city into a living coworking space.

problem.title: Problem to Solve
problem.subtitle: Remote work is here to stay, but its infrastructure is not ready yet

points.0: There is no network or ecosystem that organizes, interprets and connects the new global work dynamic.
points.1: Remote workers face uncertainty and lack of context when choosing where to work.
points.2: Spaces (cafes, coworkings, hotels) fail to connect, build loyalty or attract their ideal audience.
points.3: Companies do not offer adequate benefits to their remote teams, due to uncertainty and lack of remote work infrastructure, wasting the potential and wellbeing of their talent.

problem.conclusion: The result: a fragmented, unproductive experience without community.

solution.title: Solution
solution.subtitle: Coffi creates the contextual infrastructure for remote work, combining technology, community and environmental intelligence

0.title: Smart Matching
0.description: connects each user with the ideal space according to their context (purpose, mindset and profession).

1.title: Real-time Updates
1.description: measures and shares data on noise, occupancy, atmosphere, Wi-Fi and energy of the place.

2.title: Coffi Meetups & Events
2.description: promotes meetings, collaboration and local community.

3.title: Gamification (Coffi Points)
3.description: rewards participation and contribution to the network.

targetMarket.title: Target Market
targetMarket.users: Digital nomads, freelancers, remote workers and university students (18-40 years old).
targetMarket.spaces: Work-friendly businesses: cafes, coworkings, libraries, hotels and rooftops.
targetMarket.companies: Companies with remote teams (B2B2C): companies seeking to offer tangible benefits to their remote employees.
targetMarket.region: Initial LATAM market: Key remote work hubs → Medellín, Bogotá, CDMX, Buenos Aires and São Paulo.

0.description: Free access + premium plans with benefits, statistics and personalized recommendations.

1.description: Monthly subscription plans for work-friendly spaces with visibility, analytics, community management and positioning tools.

2.type: B2B2C – Connection between companies and spaces (future)
2.description: Companies will be able to offer Coffi benefits to their remote employees through:

features.0: Corporate dashboard with usage, productivity and wellbeing metrics.
features.1: Credits in Coffi Points for their employees to consume in allied spaces.
features.2: Partnerships with local spaces to guarantee productive experiences consistent with corporate culture.

impact.title: Social and Environmental Impact
impact.description:
Coffi promotes a sustainable model of distributed work, reducing unnecessary travel and fostering conscious use of existing urban spaces.

Furthermore, it boosts the local economy, energizing small businesses and fostering collaborative and inclusive communities.

financing.title: Financing
financing.amount: We are seeking an initial investment of USD 15,000 – 20,000 destined to completely validate the Product–Market Fit in Medellín and the Metropolitan Area, consolidating the Coffi network as a reference for new remote work in the region.

keyAreas.title: This stage will be key to:

areas.0: Perfect the MVP and its real-time infrastructure.
areas.1: Scale the local user base (B2C and B2B).
areas.2: Implement the SaaS model for work-friendly spaces.
areas.3: Optimize the rewards system and Coffi Points.

financing.beyond: Beyond capital, we seek a strategic network of mentors, allies and experts who share our vision:

seeking.0: Mentorship in growth strategy and international scalability.
seeking.1: Support in expansion to global digital nomad hubs (CDMX, Buenos Aires, São Paulo).
seeking.2: Key connections with investors, partners and leading spaces in LATAM.

financing.philosophy: Coffi is not just looking for investment, it seeks to build with its allies the network that will make the future of remote work possible.

conclusion.title: Be Where You Thrive
conclusion.description: Coffi is not just an app, it's a living network that is building the future of remote work.
